hypothesis: The exact component-C family and honest M3 anchors inherit a recent-history R prior but cannot extrapolate the league-wide within-pitcher decline. A fixed train-label-only logit offset from a damped R-season trend may correct that shared one-year-ahead calibration error without reading or aggregating target rows.

external_research_boundary.source_observation: A lower-scoring public implementation used a 0.75-damped annual base-rate trend. Its batch-mean target matching is not adopted because this project forbids target-batch aggregation; only the historical-label trend constant is retained.

fixed_recipe.historical_rate_scope: official R rows by season, seasons strictly before target Y
fixed_recipe.forecast: r_hat_Y = r_(Y-1) + 0.75 * mean(r_t - r_(t-1)) over all available consecutive historical R seasons before Y
fixed_recipe.reference_prior: q_Y = row-weighted R target mean over the most recent three seasons strictly before Y
fixed_recipe.application: for each R row independently, p_new = sigmoid(logit(p_parent) + delta_Y); each F row remains p_parent
fixed_recipe.forbidden_variant: Do not solve an offset from the mean, labels, order, distribution, or any aggregate of target/test predictions.

required_for_every_parent_and_each_devel: pitcher-cluster bootstrap 95% R gain lower bound > 0
development_gate.if_both_pass: lock the unchanged formula and open 2024 exactly once

goal_gate.G_robust: minimum of development full-score gains, locked 2024 full-score gains, and locked 2024 pitcher-cluster 95% full-score gain lower bounds across all parents
goal_gate.pass: expected_lb_lower > 1190 or an actual user-reported DACON score > 1190
